test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been divided into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

My sister, Juliet, / got married / as her / was 23.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of **"as her".**
 
• The correct phrase should be** "when she".**
 
• Therefore, the correct phrase should be "**got married when she was 23".**
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"My sister, Juliet, got married **when she **was 23."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **My sister, Juliet,** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **got married** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **was 23.** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
